gallery.title: File:Another odd ad placement... (42878412032).jpg
gallery.artist: Diego Torres Silvestre from Sao Paulo, Brazil
gallery.description:
The Brazilian economic and political situation is a trainwreck, as is the housing market, but some people are putting "Apartment for Sale" signs in some places that makes little to no sense, like this one with just "Apartment for Sale" and a telephone number handwritten and nothing more, and fixed to a lamppost on a bridge that crosses one of the most polluted rivers in the world, so you can imagine the smell.

It doesn't bother me at all, but I just can't imagine anyone deciding to buy an apartment after spot this little sign while stuck in one of the many daily traffic jams, with hundreds of motorbike couriers passing by almost trading paint with your car, and breathing a mix of exhaust fumes with the fecal smell of the Tietê River...

gallery.title: File:1973 Chevrolet C14 (38904223515).jpg
gallery.artist: Diego Torres Silvestre from Sao Paulo, Brazil
gallery.description:
Ok, I'm a Ford guy, but I can't resist a good classic like this '73 Chevy C14 pickup truck parked in front of a store in my hometown, Sao Paulo, Brazil.
Designed in Brazil by a team leaded by Luther Whitmore Stier, this pickup truck is different than the American C/K trucks of the same era, and is powered by the venerable 261 'Stovebolt' inline-six.

It's always nice to see a classic car being used like a normal car, and not an 'over-restored' trailer-queen.

gallery.title: File:Almost SOOC... (42260139355).jpg
gallery.artist: Diego Torres Silvestre from Sao Paulo, Brazil
gallery.description:
To be honest, I don't even bother to use the manual controls of the Moto Z Play (Gen 1) too much because a mediocre camera is a mediocre camera no matter what you try to do to improve it.

The light was a little bit on the challenging side on the train station, and the Automatic Mode went completely crazy trying to cope with this scenery, but I really liked the result, so much that I almost didn't touch on it, just minor adjustments like rotation correction, cropping and sharpening.
